text: Static review after the initial implementation found a JVM race in AsyncBatch's shared next-index counter. Work claiming is now synchronized across callback threads while preserving deterministic result ordering and ReadLimits.maxConcurrentRequests; the concurrency test's counters and JVM HTTP traces are likewise synchronized. The blocking codec bridge now takes its dedicated ExecutionContext explicitly instead of potentially reusing the callback context by implicit accident. Full JVM/Scala.js execution evidence is still pending, so Z8.5 remains doing.
